title: Conformance case expected result
description: What every binding's query.json must produce: the _id list, the documents themselves, or both.

ids.description: Document _id values, in the exact order Find() must return them. Omit only when the query projects _id away and there are no ids to check — then `docs` carries the whole assertion.

fields.description: Optional. Document fields to check beyond _id/order, e.g. ["_id", "age", "name"]. The runner takes the documents Find() returned and narrows each one down to these fields before comparing against `docs`. That narrowing is client-side and flat — it predates projection support and stays for cases that deliberately query whole documents but only want a few fields spelled out in expected.json. A case testing projection sets `docs` WITHOUT `fields`, so the shape the engine produced is what gets compared.

docs.description: The documents Find() must return, in order. With `fields` set, each object holds only the keys listed there and is compared against the client-side narrowing. Without `fields`, each object is compared against the returned document in full — which is how a `projection` in query.json is checked.
